notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33170718/0d585e3b7f9da6070796124b4d75bb17ae28629b.gif

New update is available!

New content and features :
- 11 new musics from Zone Tripper, Morgan Willis and Hugo Williame!
- New game content : ramps
- New bonus : Jumper
- New malus : VHS
- New sounds for collision, motor, turbo...
- Bot generation area increased
- Collisions improved
- Buildings quality increased
- Other little bug fixes and improvements
